expectations.evidence: The answer actively disparages manual CPC rather than defending it: item 1 says switch to Maximize Conversions 'not manual CPC' and that this 'is better than sitting on manual CPC, which wastes the auction-time signals Google could already be using.' The whole frame is a ladder toward Smart Bidding — 'don't switch yet,' the stepping-stone strategy 'for low-volume accounts,' and reaching 30/50 conversions — so manual CPC is implicitly a holding pattern until volume arrives.
